Microsoft (MSFT) vs Broadcom (AVGO): on the same formula, their operating margins are 6.9 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — MSFT: $331.8B · AVGO: $63.9B
• Revenue growth — MSFT: +17.8% · AVGO: +23.9%
• Operating margin — MSFT: 46.8% · AVGO: 39.9%
• Net margin — MSFT: 40.3% · AVGO: 36.2%
• Free cash flow margin — MSFT: 20.2% · AVGO: 42.1%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — MSFT: 13.7% · AVGO: 23.5%

Different fiscal years: MSFT Jun 30, 2026 · AVGO Nov 2, 2025. The periods are not identical.
